rca of the issue: Root cause of failing backend contract: CORSMiddleware in /app/backend/server.py is configured as allow_credentials=False and allow_origins from env includes wildcard '*'. Credentialed browser auth with httpOnly cookie requires explicit origin echo + access-control-allow-credentials:true. Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin header returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and no access-control-allow-credentials header. Mitigation: set explicit allow_origins list (frontend domain(s)) and allow_credentials=True.
